text: {Name}, a quarry worker from {Place}, deserted a resistance position during an attack. A surviving fighter later reported that a companion had stayed to defend the position and been killed.
self_review: A quarry worker deserted a resistance position and later learned that a companion who stayed had died.
source_pattern: The supplied Bleichman testimony describes flight during a camp attack, later return, and burial of dead companions.
fictional_changes: The quarry work, assigned position, desertion, and particular companion are invented. Historical escape is not being labeled desertion.
